```sql
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)") / NULLIF(SUM("Enrollment (K-12)"), 0) * 100, 2) AS free_meal_rate
FROM main."frpm"
WHERE "County Name" = 'Alameda'
  AND "Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
```
